purpose: f17 micromixer DEVELOPMENT evidence: refined-rung (h = 7.071 um) two-mesh and maximum-Pe scalar-layer witnesses, the 8-design public triage panel, controls and a cold repeat on pod hardware, judged in place against F17-SCIENCE-VALUES-01 bands registered before these runs. Public decks only; no qualification.

recommended.basis: 13 cases, 1 vCPU each; summed estimate 11 550 CPU-s (8 x 650 primary, 2 x 2450 refined, 2 x 400 controls, 650 cold repeat) = 3.2 CPU-h; with refined witnesses started first (reservation_order) the two ~55-min refined cases bound the wall and the other 11 cases fill the remaining 6 cores in about two waves; peak concurrent memory about 2 x 2.6 + 6 x 0.9 = 10.6 GiB. Worst case = 150-min deadline x $0.24/h (cpu3c 8 vCPU). Primary and control estimates are measured on local-dev-4vcpu-15g-contended (f17-local-costs.json); the refined estimate is EXTRAPOLATED and this pod measures it.
recommended.timing_calibration_note: cpu3c timings are not the D3 timing-calibration set (reference hardware runpod-cpu5c-16vcpu). Running this same plan on cpu5c 16 vCPU would also serve D3 for these 13 case kinds; worst case 150 min x 16 vCPU x $0.035 = $1.40.

steps.name: f17-triage
steps.judges: D1 two-mesh on both witnesses (h10 vs h7.071 at Q 5 uL/min, D 0.5e-10: |dM| <= 0.02, |dp|/dp <= 5 %, volumes within B5); D2 maximum-Pe scalar layer on both rungs (M(D 0.5e-10) - M(D 0) >= 0.02; verdict PRIMARY_ADEQUATE / REFINED_RUNG_REQUIRED / HIGH_PE_UNRESOLVED); D3 limitedLinear01 diagnostic (reported only); D5 cross-hardware parity of the cold repeat vs the panel (bitwise, else <= 1e-4 flagged NONDETERMINISTIC); C1-C4 controls on pod hardware (C1 Poiseuille <= 3.0 % at h10, <= 1.5 % at h7.071, order in [1.5, 2.5]; C2 max |c - 1| <= 1e-6; C3 |M - M_ref| <= 0.01; C4 M <= 1e-3) with C5 from the committed periodic result; triage answer inputs per design (worst-M over nine conditions, max dp vs 250 Pa, residence at 1 uL/min) and F9 value check B (worst-M spread >= 0.05 among admissible designs per floor 0.80/0.85). All bands: .agent/decisions/2026-10-15-F17-SCIENCE-VALUES-01.md Observer runs before scratch cleanup; raw fields are not inferred from retained logs.
